visualCharacteristics: A horizontally-scrolling carousel of product cards, showing up to 4 cards per view on desktop (2 on tablet, ~1 on mobile). Each card has an image on top, a tag, title, description, and a link. Prev/next arrows and slide indicators.
contentPattern: One row per product card: [image | content (tag + heading + description + link)].
usage: 'More from Saga' style product/cross-sell carousel showing multiple cards per view with paging controls.
